mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for construction businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO relies heavily on manual analysis and established best practices. AEO, however, uses AI algorithms to automate and enhance this process. It can identify complex patterns and predictive insights that human analysts might miss, such as real-time keyword fluctuations or emerging industry trends. This allows for more agile and precise optimization strategies, adapting faster to search engine updates and competitor moves, providing a competitive edge for construction firms.
